Context: 5. Honorarium admissible for specific cases.

- (a} The Competent Authority should exercise its utmost care- in the matter of grant of honorarium and may do so onfy in absolutely deserving case.
- (b) The number of disciplinary cases should be restricted to 10 cases in a year with not more than 2 cases at a time for serving Government servants. For retired Government servants empanelled as Inquiry Officers, it should be restricted to 8 cases in a year and 4 cases at a time.
